description: This file defines the ResetPasswordRequest entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the ohrm_reset_password database table, and includes properties such as id, resetEmail, resetRequestDate, resetCode, and expired with associated getter and setter methods.

classes.name: ResetPasswordRequest
classes.description: Entity class representing a reset password request, mapped to ohrm_reset_password table, with properties for id, email, date, code, and expiration status.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reset password request.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reset password request.

methods.name: getResetEmail
methods.description: Returns the email associated with the reset request.

methods.name: setResetEmail
methods.description: Sets the email associated with the reset request.

methods.name: getResetRequestDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the reset request was made.

methods.name: setResetRequestDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the reset request was made.

methods.name: getResetCode
methods.description: Returns the reset code for the password reset.

methods.name: setResetCode
methods.description: Sets the reset code for the password reset.

methods.name: getExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the reset request is expired.

methods.name: setExpired
methods.description: Sets the expiration status of the reset request.
